orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The €900,000 school furniture programme should be divided into three lots to ensure compliance with budget and lot value constraints. Lot 1 (Classroom Furniture Set 1) with an estimated value of €200,000 (25% of the budget) will focus on furniture made from sustainably sourced wood or recycled materials. Lot 2 (Classroom Furniture Set 2) with an estimated value of €200,000 (25% of the budget) will focus on furniture designed for energy efficiency in manufacturing and use. Lot 3 (Common Area Furniture) with an estimated value of €100,000 (10% of the budget) will focus on low-VOC materials to ensure indoor air quality. The award criterion for each lot will be a best price-quality ratio, weighted 60% price and 40% quality.
